visual_review.notes: Parallax Fencers H3 actions: reviewed all 992 chronological originals across eight takes and all 257 selected frames at 128px reference height. Accepted two-step reciprocal walk, fencing lunge (contact source47), impact recoil, held high parry, physical sword salute keeping the golden dagger, and kneel/side-topple/face-down death. One cross-dissolved frame each excluded from move and hit. Rejected support v1 (backdrop color cycling, lost dagger) and death v1 (kneel-to-prone snap). Eight accepted idle poses retained exactly. Candidate 854 focused Windows checks passed; no continuous playback or manual playtest claim.
